launcher.title: Launchers
launcher.noGames: Add a game to get its commands.
launcher.hint: Commands for the launcher to notify the hub before the game starts. The hub watches for the close on its own: no close hook needed.
launcher.saveFirst: Save the game to get its commands.
launcher.noDevices: Choose the game's devices to get its commands.
launcher.noKey: Generate the API key in your profile first.
launcher.noProcess: No process: the hub will not be able to watch for the close (the open notice will still work).
launcher.hubUrlHint: Address the launcher uses to reach the hub. Defaults to this page's; remembered in this browser.
launcher.invalidUrl: Invalid URL: use http:// or https://, with no spaces or quotes.

where.steam: Paste it in the game's Properties → Launch Options (a single line).
where.lutris: Paste it in Configure → System options → Pre-launch script. Turn on “Wait for pre-launch completion”.
where.heroic: Paste it in the game's settings → Advanced → script to run before launch.
where.windows: Paste it in Playnite → Edit game → Scripts → pre-start script (PowerShell 5.1).

launcher.closeNote: The hub watches for the close on its own.

autosync.title: Automatic sync
autosync.intro: Syncs all games at regular intervals. If a sync is already running, that cycle is skipped.
autosync.range: Enter a number between {min} and {max} hours.
autosync.runOnStart: Also run when the application starts

help.skip: Skip: nothing is saved and the game is marked “Conflict” so you can resolve it by hand. This is the safe option.
help.newest: Newest wins: the save with the newest date is applied and the other is kept in versions. If the dates differ by less than 2 s, it is skipped.

none.title: No runs
none.text: No automatic sync has run yet. Runs will appear here.

dialog.preWarn: This is a pre-release from the testing channel: it may fail.
dialog.noNotes: This version has no release notes.
dialog.manual: Checkpoint does not update itself: download the new version, rebuild the web app and restart Checkpoint.

check.title: Check for updates
check.text: Looks up the versions published on GitHub (read-only, every few hours) and notifies you if there is a new one. It installs nothing.
check.limited: You just checked; wait a minute before checking again.

channel.help: Stable: only versions published as final. Testing: also includes pre-release versions, which may fail.

summary.disabled: Checking is disabled: no requests are made to the internet.
summary.newerPre: A new pre-release version is available: {latest} (installed: {current}).
summary.noData: Installed version: {current}. There is no data on the latest version yet.

keyhelp.intro: Copy it and add it to authorized_keys on each device. Press ? to see the steps.
keyhelp.infoAria: Info: steps to register the key
keyhelp.lead: Checkpoint uses its own SSH key to log in, without a password, to each device and copy its saved games. The public part must be registered on each device.

s1.title: Copy the key
s1.text: Press {copy} under the public key box. It is Checkpoint's key: you do not need to generate one on your PC.

s2.title: Paste it on the remote device
s2.hint: On each device Checkpoint connects to. Choose its system.

keyhelp.noKey: No key is visible yet: replace {placeholder} with the copied key.
keyhelp.oneLine: In authorized_keys the key takes a single line, looking like this:
keyhelp.windowsNote: Keep the default shell (cmd.exe) and use a local user.

s3.title: Check the connection
s3.text: On the device card, press {test}. It should answer {ok}. The first time, it saves the device's fingerprint.

keyhelp.warn: Paste only the public key (one line starting with ssh-ed25519). NEVER a private key.
keyhelp.inOrder: Run them in order, one at a time.
keyhelp.pickOne: Pick only one of the options, depending on the firewall you use.

winUser.title: Paste the key (regular user)
winUser.hint: In PowerShell, as the user Checkpoint will connect with.

winAdmin.title: Paste the key (administrator user)
winAdmin.hint: If that user is an administrator, the key goes in a different file. PowerShell as administrator.

archInstall.title: Install and enable the SSH server
archInstall.hint: In a terminal. The service is called sshd.

archFirewall.title: Open port 22 (only if there is a firewall)
archFirewall.hint: Arch has no firewall enabled by default. Use whichever you have.

linuxKey.title: Paste the key into authorized_keys
linuxKey.hint: As the user Checkpoint will connect with (no sudo).

debInstall.title: Install and enable the SSH server
debInstall.hint: In a terminal. The service is called ssh.

debFirewall.title: Open port 22 (only if ufw is active)
debFirewall.hint: Check first with sudo ufw status.

apikey.title: API key
apikey.hint: For launcher and plugin notifications (/api/hook/*). It gives no access to the web UI or settings.
apikey.none: There is no API key yet.

regenerate.title: Regenerate the API key
regenerate.text: The current key will stop working: commands and plugins already linked will fail until you use the new one.

revoke.title: Revoke the API key
revoke.text: Linked commands and plugins will stop working. You can generate a new key whenever you want.
